The leather-like texture is slightly repetitive and lacks the fine, random micro-detail of real leather. It has a 'painted' or overly smooth quality in the highlights, though it is not a catastrophic failure.

The top edges of the adjacent binders show slight warping and inconsistency in parallelism. The teal binder on the left seems to merge slightly into the background/shelf area without a sharp boundary.
